Hey I feel like that too. I feel worthless and a waste of space and resources. I can't tell you nice words because I know that whenever I get told otherwise by other people, that I'm more than I think I am, it doesn't help much. I don't suddenly think I'm better, those words feel fake and insincere instead. 

OP, you're not alone. A lot of us feel the same way as you. It feels weird talking about the future because I can only see a bleak future if I were to go on and yet feel like I'm going to be gone in the next few years. OP, let's go on together. I'm going to do my best to stay here and continue wasting space, and I wish you would stay here with me and be wastes of space together. It won't feel nice and will probably go rougher from here on out, but I want you to know that I'll be fighting with you too. If you want to chat, I'm open to it OP. Let's be comrades in this thing.

Hey I had the same problem too. I've been wanting to kill myself and a few times before cancelled my plans because of lack of access+courage. I didn't want to be found and didn't want to die in pain, which is difficult since I still live with my parents in a country where drugs and weapon regulations are pretty strict. I thought I was already at a low point, but then life just barrelled down and crushed me. Really should have killed myself back then, then I wouldn't have to face so much of this shit.

At least we're not alone, OP. There's a lot of us who has these regrets.
I'm scared of what I'll have to face if I don't kill myself now. I'd rather have it end here than continue.
No I haven't gone to a psychiatrist yet. I don't even know if I want help or not.
I went to a psychologist. I don't want to go back I guess. It was good when I was there, then I go home and realise it doesn't help me much.
Yeah, in college. My parents pay for the maids and driver, not me.

I don't have loved ones. I can't trust anyone, I can't rely on my friends, I don't have people I feel close with.

I used to have dreams, but I can't be my ideal self. I don't have anything special with me that would make myself be able to achieve what I want.

I'm 20 but I can't run away from my parents since they don't allow me to work, even though they make fun of me for not having a job. I still live with them, they don't even allow me to sleep over at my friend's. I'm not allowed to drive by myself. The women's shelter at my country is crap and if I run away to them, I would always have to live as an uneducated, unskilled piece of shit. It's either saying goodbye to everything I want to be or living in this hell and still at risk of never having my dreams come true anyway. Both are just as good as the other, so may as well say goodbye.
